Title: General availability: Git integration for API Management

Body.Content:
The Git integration feature for Azure API Management has been in preview for a couple of months. We have received great feedback and made some improvements to it. We are delighted to announce that the feature is now generally available.

 

For more information about Git integration, see the article How to save and configure your API Management service configuration using Git.
